steps.name: 实际构建 Cocoa 窗口、加载3D模型、保存截图
cmd:
from pathlib import Path;import sys,json,selftest;d=Path(sys.argv[1]);p=d/'preview'/'shape.ply';p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text('ply
format ascii 1.0
element vertex 4
property float x
property float y
property float z
element face 4
property list uchar int vertex_indices
end_header
0 0 0
1 0 0
0 1 0
0 0 1
3 0 2 1
3 0 1 3
3 0 3 2
3 1 2 3
'.replace(chr(10),chr(10)));r=selftest.check_gui(d);(d/'selftest_report.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8');assert r['ok_bool'] and r['detail']['preview_loaded_bool'] and sys.argv[2] in r['detail']['window_title_str']
